podcast.body: The first single from "Tango in the Night," this song showcased quintessential Lindsey Buckingham style, with backing vocals from other Mac members and Buckingham himself modifying his voice to sound female. It peaked at number five, indicating the public's excitement for the band after a five-year absence. "When Tango's first single, Big Love, arrived in March 1987, it sounded like quintessential Buckingham, with backing vocals from the other Mac members, and even Lindsey himself, modifying his own voice to sound female."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
